name: Grain and vignette texture
looks: Fine film grain moves subtly over every frame at low opacity, a radial vignette darkens the edges of each flat colour field, and faint walls of ghost outline type drift behind kinetic words. Together these stop a flat field from reading as a plain slide.
build: Fill a small canvas once with seeded noise and tile it as a repeating background, offsetting its position each frame from a seeded random function of the frame number so the grain moves but renders identically on any repeat seek; layer a radial gradient vignette per field tinted toward its darkest colour; and drift 1px outline-stroke text walls slowly on a linear ease.
prompt: Lay a constant, subtle texture over the whole film: fine moving grain, a soft vignette darkening the edges of every flat field, and the occasional faint drifting wall of outline type behind bold text. Keep it as a near-invisible layer that stops colour fields from reading as flat slides, and drive it harder only at impact or glitch beats rather than at one uniform strength throughout.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; built in examples/reel-2026-10-06.html, // ===== grain and the FX layer.
